description: This file defines system API endpoints for Mattermost, including health checks, support packet generation, configuration testing, audit retrieval, cache invalidation, log management, notifications, server control, upgrades, notices, onboarding, schema migrations, and URL redirection. It contains route handlers, utility functions, and constants specific to system-level operations within the Mattermost server.

methods.name: generateSupportPacket
methods.description: Handles support packet generation, including permission check, license validation, support packet creation, zip file writing, and streaming response.

methods.name: supportPacketFileName
methods.description: Generates a filename for the support packet zip file based on current time and customer name.

methods.name: getSystemPing
methods.description: Performs health check of the server, database, and file storage, returning status and version info.

methods.name: testNotifications
methods.description: Sends a test push notification message to verify notification system.

methods.name: testEmail
methods.description: Tests email configuration by sending a test email.

methods.name: testSiteURL
methods.description: Tests the provided site URL for validity.

methods.name: getAudits
methods.description: Retrieves audit logs with permission check.

methods.name: databaseRecycle
methods.description: Recycles database connections, requires admin permission.

methods.name: invalidateCaches
methods.description: Invalidates all caches, requires admin permission.

methods.name: queryLogs
methods.description: Queries logs based on filter, with permission check.

methods.name: getLogs
methods.description: Retrieves logs with permission check.

methods.name: downloadLogs
methods.description: Downloads log file, with permission check.

methods.name: postLog
methods.description: Receives client logs and writes them to the server, with permission checks.

methods.name: getAnalytics
methods.description: Retrieves analytics data, permission required.

methods.name: getLatestVersion
methods.description: Fetches latest server version info from GitHub, permission required.

methods.name: getSupportedTimezones
methods.description: Returns supported timezones.

methods.name: testS3
methods.description: Tests S3 file storage connection with provided config.

methods.name: getRedirectLocation
methods.description: Resolves URL redirection location, caches results.

methods.name: pushNotificationAck
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment of push notifications, updates session props, and forwards ack.

methods.name: setServerBusy
methods.description: Marks server as busy for specified seconds, permission required.

methods.name: clearServerBusy
methods.description: Clears server busy state, permission required.

methods.name: getServerBusyExpires
methods.description: Returns server busy expiration info, permission required.

methods.name: upgradeToEnterprise
methods.description: Initiates server upgrade to enterprise, permission required.

methods.name: upgradeToEnterpriseStatus
methods.description: Checks upgrade progress status.

methods.name: isAllowedToUpgradeToEnterprise
methods.description: Checks if server is allowed to upgrade to enterprise, permission required.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Restarts the server, permission required.

methods.name: getProductNotices
methods.description: Retrieves product notices for a team.

methods.name: updateViewedProductNotices
methods.description: Marks product notices as viewed.

methods.name: getOnboarding
methods.description: Retrieves onboarding info for first admin setup.

methods.name: completeOnboarding
methods.description: Completes onboarding process with provided data.

methods.name: getAppliedSchemaMigrations
methods.description: Retrieves applied database schema migrations.
